summary: Fallen climber in Eldorado Canyon State Park found after a passerby heard cries for help ~8:30 a.m. near the Red Garden Wall/Yellow Spur climbing area; carried down a scree field and hoisted over South Boulder Creek by rope system to an ambulance; non-life-threatening injuries; ~3-hour rescue
location: Red Garden Wall / Yellow Spur area, Eldorado Canyon State Park
notes: Summarized from EMS1/Sacramento Bee report of the BCSO news release; cries heard ~8:30 a.m. Wednesday 2025-07-30.
